column1: # Bangladesh revised Bengali calendar — golden reference data
# PROVENANCE. Generated by running TWO independent MIT-licensed implementations
# of the revised Bengali calendar (the standard adopted in Bangladesh in 1987)
# and keeping only rows on which they agree. They agreed on all 1461 days.
#   1. bangla (Python)  - Copyright (c) 2017 Ahmedur Rahman Shovon, MIT
# Month spellings normalised to the Latin transliterations used in panchang.js.
# WHAT THIS IS NOT. This is the ARITHMETIC Bangladesh calendar: fixed month
# lengths, Pohela Boishakh pinned to 14 April every year. It is NOT the
# Vishuddha Siddhanta drik panjika followed in West Bengal, which is
# astronomical and disagrees with this by 0-3 days through the year. Neither
# is a substitute for the other, and neither validates the other's tithi,
# nakshatra, yoga or karana - none of which these references compute at all.
